input.symbols: explicit --symbols or derived from M115 paper router JSON paper_positions
input.ibkr_api_call: reqMktData stock snapshot-style subscription followed by cancelMktData

downstream.normalized_field: marks[] with symbol, mark_price, mark_source, mark_timestamp

safety.description: M117 requests stock market-data marks only, cancels subscriptions, and writes normalized marks for paper mark-to-market. It must not call broker order APIs, transmit orders, or mutate a real portfolio.

latest_validation.note: M115 fills are synthetic at a 100 reference price, so M117 paper PnL validates the mark feed and downstream plumbing but is not yet a realistic strategy PnL.
